_readme: Edit freely. To add a question, copy any entry into the right tier and give it a new unique id (L/P/D/C + number). To remove one, delete its entry. Round 1 draws one random `light` question, round 2 one random `personal` question, and round 3 one random `collab` card (every pair gets the same card). `deep` questions are only used inside collab cards: a card containing {deep} gets a random deep question substituted in. Each collab card's `submitPrompt` is what each partner types as their one result. Tags are optional labels for sorting and pruning; the game logic does not depend on them. Keep everything comfortable for strangers, since judges will be playing.

light.text: Rank these and defend your #1: breakfast tacos, brisket, queso, boba.
You get a free afternoon in Austin after this hackathon. What are you actually doing?
Pick one for a group hangout: bowling, karaoke, a board game cafe, or a late-night food run. Convince the others.

What's your go-to order at the place you go to way too often?

What's one thing in your bag right now that would surprise us?
